meanings.usage: 指农村或小镇，比 town 小
用于装钱和信用卡的小皮具
常用复数形式，指存起来的钱
复数形式为 thieves，指偷窃的人
形容人不欺骗，实话实说
wrap up 表示包裹起来
用于阅读新闻或包裹东西
表示某物内部装有某物
return sth. to sb. 表示归还某物给某人
a sum of money 表示一笔钱
front door 指前门，建筑物入口

phrases.phrase: take savings to the post office

examples.en: She took her savings to the post office to send them to her son.
examples.zh: 她把积蓄带到邮局寄给儿子。

phrases.usage: 一定曾经是（对过去的肯定推测）

examples.en: The wallet must have been found by someone.
examples.zh: 钱包一定是被某人发现了。

examples.en: The package was wrapped up in newspaper.
In time, all the money was paid back.
examples.zh: 最终，所有的钱都还回来了。

examples.en: He paid back the money he had borrowed.
A large sum of money was lost.
Three months passed by before the wallet was found.
examples.zh: 三个月过去了，钱包才被找到。

examples.en: The wallet contained the money together with a note.
examples.zh: 钱包里有钱和一张纸条。

phrases.usage: 只是百分之五十的小偷

examples.en: I'm only 50 per cent a thief now!
examples.zh: 我现在只是百分之五十的小偷！

examples.en: The whole village soon learnt that money had been lost.
examples.zh: 整个村庄很快得知钱丢了。

phrases.usage: /pəʊst ˈɒfɪs/ noun. 邮局（邮寄信件和包裹的地方）

grammar.title: must have + 过去分词（对过去的肯定推测）
grammar.structure: 主语 + must have + 过去分词 + ...
grammar.definition: 表示对过去发生的事情的肯定推测，意为'一定已经...' 用于根据证据或理由推断过去发生的事情，语气肯定

examples.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
examples.zh: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民发现了。

examples.en: She must have received my letter.

grammar.title: 过去完成时（Past Perfect Tense）
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作 用于叙述过去事件时，表示先发生的动作，常与一般过去时连用

examples.en: Sam had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
examples.zh: 萨姆在把积蓄带到邮局的路上丢了钱包。

examples.en: Three months passed after the wallet had been lost.

grammar.title: 被动语态（Passive Voice）
grammar.definition: 强调动作的承受者而非执行者 当动作的承受者更重要或不知道执行者时使用

examples.en: The wallet must have been found.
examples.zh: 钱包一定被（某人）发现了。

examples.en: All Sam's money was paid back in this way.
examples.zh: 萨姆所有的钱都以这种方式被还了回来。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + must have + 过去分词

original.en: The wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
original.zh: 钱包一定是被某个村民发现了。

imitations.en: The book must have been taken by Tom.
imitations.zh: 那本书一定是被汤姆拿走了。

imitations.en: She must have forgotten our appointment.
imitations.zh: 她一定忘了我们的约定。

patterns.pattern: It had been + 过去分词 + in/with...

original.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money.
original.zh: 它用报纸包着，里面有丢失金额的一半。

imitations.en: The letter had been hidden in the drawer.
The money had been placed in a safe box.

patterns.pattern: In time, + 主语 + was/were + 过去分词

original.en: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
original.zh: 最终，萨姆所有的钱都以这种方式还了回来。

imitations.en: In time, the problem was solved.
In time, the truth was known by everyone.
imitations.zh: 最终，真相被所有人知道了。

patterns.pattern: Only + 数字/百分比 + 名词/名词短语

original.zh: 只是百分之五十的小偷！

imitations.en: Only 20 per cent of the work is done.
imitations.zh: 只完成了百分之二十的工作。

imitations.en: Only half a loaf of bread left.

lines.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
lines.zh: 整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。当地的屠户萨姆。

lines.en: Sam Benton, the local butcher , had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
lines.zh: 本顿在把存款送往邮局的途中把钱包丢了。

lines.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him.
lines.zh: 萨姆确信那钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了，可是却不见有人来送还给他。

lines.en: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
lines.zh: 3个月过去了，后来在一天早晨，萨姆在自己的大门外发现了他的钱包。

lines.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note which said: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!
lines.zh: 钱包是用报纸包着的，里面有他丢失的钱的一半，而且还附着一张纸条，上面写着：“一个小偷，是的，但只是一个50%的小偷！

lines.en: Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note: 'Only 25 per cent a thief now!
lines.zh: ”又过了两个月，又有一些钱送还给了萨姆，又附了一张字条：“这回只是25%的小偷了！

lines.en: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
lines.zh: ”很快，萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。

lines.en: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
lines.zh: 最后的那张字条上写道：“我现在是一个100%的诚实人了！”

questions.q: How did Sam get his money back?
questions.zh: 萨姆是怎样把钱要回来的？
questions.a: The thief returned it bit by bit: three months later the wallet, wrapped up in newspaper and containing half the money, was left outside Sam's front door; two months later some more money was sent with a second note, and in time all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
questions.aZh: 小偷分批归还：三个月后用报纸包着的钱包出现在萨姆家门口，里面只有一半的钱；两个月后又送来一些钱；最终全部还了回来。

questions.q: How did Sam lose his wallet?
questions.zh: 萨姆是怎么把钱包弄丢的？
questions.a: He lost it while taking his savings to the post office.
questions.aZh: 他在把存款送往邮局的途中把钱包丢了。

questions.q: What did Sam think had happened to the wallet?
questions.zh: 萨姆认为钱包出了什么事？
questions.a: He was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him.
questions.aZh: 他确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了，可是却不见有人来送还给他。

questions.q: How much money came back the first time, and what did the three notes say?
questions.zh: 第一次送回来多少钱？三张字条分别写了什么？
questions.a: The wallet contained half the money he had lost. The notes said: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!', then 'Only 25 per cent a thief now!', and finally 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
questions.aZh: 第一次只有他丢失钱数的一半；字条依次写着“50%的小偷”“现在只是25%的小偷”“我现在100%诚实”。

questions.q: Why did the thief return the money little by little instead of all at once?
questions.zh: 这个“小偷”为什么不一次性还清，而要分期还钱？
questions.a: Because his conscience troubled him: he wanted the money but could not bear to be a whole thief, so he returned it in instalments and cut his 'thief percentage' each time until he could call himself 100 per cent honest.
questions.aZh: 因为良心不安：他既舍不得那笔钱，又不愿当十足的小偷，于是分批还钱、一次次降低自己的“小偷百分比”。
questions.hint: 结合标题与三张字条的百分比递减。

translation:
整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。
当地的屠户萨姆。
本顿在把存款送往邮局的途中把钱包丢了。
萨姆确信那钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了，可是却不见有人来送还给他。
3个月过去了，后来在一天早晨，萨姆在自己的大门外发现了他的钱包。
钱包是用报纸包着的，里面有他丢失的钱的一半，而且还附着一张纸条，上面写着：“一个小偷，是的，但只是一个50%的小偷！
”又过了两个月，又有一些钱送还给了萨姆，又附了一张字条：“这回只是25%的小偷了！
”很快，萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。
最后的那张字条上写道：“我现在是一个100%的诚实人了！”
title: A Clear Conscience
subtitle: 问心无愧

lead.question: 捡到钱包的人为何一次次还钱，最后还自称100%诚实？
lead.warmup: 一个屠户在去邮局存钱的路上丢了钱包，全村人都知道了这件事。钱没有立刻被送回，却在三个月后出现在他家门口——用报纸包着，里面只剩一半的钱，还夹着一张字条：“一个小偷，是的，但只是一个50%的小偷！”此后钱被分批送回，字条上的百分比一路下降。
goals: 复述故事脉络：丢钱包—三个月后归还一半—分批还清
掌握过去完成时被动与 must have been done 的被动推测
掌握 while＋现在分词的省略结构及其同主语条件
活用 wrap up、pay back、in time、per cent、savings 等表达
lead.summary: 本课讲述屠户萨姆丢失钱包后，钱被匿名者用报纸分批包好送回，字条上的“50%”“25%”一路降到“我现在100%诚实”。语言点：过去完成时被动与 must have been found、while＋现在分词省略、wrap up、pay back、in time、per cent。
lead.tips: in time 此处＝“最终／经过一段时间”，不是 on time（准时）；while 后接现在分词时，其逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。

exercises.q: 填空（注意时态与语态）：The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money ______ (lose).
用 while 的省略结构补全：had lost his wallet ______ (take) his savings to the post office.
解释标题 A clear conscience 中 clear 的含义，并写出本课中文标题。
exercises.a: clear 意为“清白的、无罪的”（innocent / free from guilt）；中文标题为“问心无愧”。

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：① Someone stole Sam's wallet on the way to the post office. ② Someone sent some more money to Sam two months later.
exercises.a: ① Sam's wallet was stolen on the way to the post office. ② Some more money was sent to Sam two months later.

exercises.q: 汉译英：钱包是用报纸包着的，里面有他丢失的钱的一半。
exercises.a: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost.

exercises.q: 汉译英：很快，萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。
exercises.a: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.

exercises.q: 首字母填空：Sam lost his w______ while taking his s______ to the post office; he was sure one of the v______ had found it, and the note said he was only 50 p______ c______ a thief.

quiz.q: “整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。”正确的英文表达是：
options: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had lost.
The whole village soon learns that a large sum of money has lost.
The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money was losing.

quiz.q: 萨姆是在什么情况下丢的钱包？
options: while taking his savings to the post office
while he had taken his savings to the post office
after he had taken his savings from the post office
before taking his savings to the bank

quiz.q: “萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了”，对应的英文是：
options: He was sure the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
He was sure the wallet must be found by one of the villagers.
He was sure the wallet must have found one of the villagers.
He was sure the wallet had to find one of the villagers.

quiz.q: “钱包是用报纸包着的”，正确的英文是：
options: It had been wrapped up in newspaper.
It had wrapped up in newspaper.
It was wrapping up in newspaper.
It has been wrapping up in newspaper.

quiz.q: “很快，萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。”
options: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
On time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
In time, all Sam's money paid back in this way.
At time, all Sam's money had paid back in this way.

quiz.q: 最后那张字条上写着：“我现在是一个100%的诚实人了！”
options: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
The last note said: 'I am 100 per cents honest now!'
The last note said: 'I have 100 per cent honesty now!'
The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent a thief now!'
